column1: # Roast readings between releases that ROAST.md never carried.
# From 2026-09-21 to v5.0.0 the Roast work ran as bursts, and each full run was
# recorded in the commit that it gated, not in docs/status/ROAST.md, whose
# headline stayed at 810 files until the v5.0.0 commit. Without these rows the
# Roast charts jump from the Sep 20 sitting straight to 1,423 files, and two
# weeks of climbing look like one step.
# Each row is ONE full Roast run as a rakupp commit message states it, and
# gives that commit. Files are fully-passing files of the set that run used:
# the whole checkout (1,464) up to 5a08968d, Roast's spectest.data (1,434)
# after it, and 1,424 after the 2026-09-28 Roast pull. Tests are declared
# tests with skip and todo counted as passes, the measure the chart draws; `-`
# where the message did not state that figure or its total. Ordered by time
# within a day.
# date        commit    files  of     tests   of      note
2026-09-26    d0a4436b  1189   1434   -       -       spectest.data's 1,434 files from here
2026-09-28    c2161341  1401   1424   -       -       after the Roast pull: 1,424 files listed
